name: io.github.bosmdavid-gif/dropthehassle
description: One platform for domain, hosting, email, analytics and your back-end. AI native, no DNS.
title: DropTheHassle

environmentVariables.name: DTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your DropTheHassle account token from the dashboard. The agent uses it to act on your account. It can deploy and manage, but there is no endpoint to spend money.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Show which DropTheHassle account and plan the token belongs to.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: List the sites in your account with their live links and status.

tools.name: search_domain
tools.description: Check if a domain is available and what it costs, before you buy.

tools.name: deploy_site
tools.description: Put a site online, or push an update to a site you already have.

tools.name: point_domain
tools.description: Connect a domain you own to a site and set its DNS, redirects and email.

tools.name: choose_link
tools.description: Rename a site's free link to a chosen name, with the old link redirecting.

tools.name: set_backend
tools.description: Link your own backend (Railway, Render, anywhere) behind your domain: API paths or the whole site reverse-proxy to it.
